surfaces.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#262626] rounded-md focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#2563EB]

layout_strategy.dashboard: Control Room Grid. Left Sidebar (w-64) for nav and recent chats. Main Content split: Left pane for Repo/Search, Right pane for Chat.
layout_strategy.auth: Split screen layout. Left side: Abstract dark image. Right side: Centered login/register form.
layout_strategy.spacing: Auth uses generous spacing (p-8 to p-12). Dashboard uses tight spacing (p-4 to p-6) for data density.

auth_background.description: Abstract dark minimal background for auth screens

animation_rules.hover: Subtle border color change, slight opacity change on text.
animation_rules.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive elements.
animation_rules.loading: Use skeleton loaders for repo ingestion and chat response loading.

accessibility_testing.data_testids: REQUIRED on all interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='repo-input'
accessibility_testing.contrast: Ensure text over #141414 meets WCAG AA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize and enforce the DARK theme. Map the provided colors to tailwind config.
Implement JWT Authentication. Store token in localStorage. Protect Dashboard route.
Build Auth flows (Login & Register) using the specified split-screen layout.
Build the Dashboard UI to handle GitHub Repo Ingestion, Chat Interface, and Semantic Search seamlessly.
Add functional loading states (Skeletons) during data fetching and AI thinking.
Ensure graceful error handling with toasts or inline error messages.
Do NOT over-engineer the UI. Keep it clean, minimal, and functional for developers.
